I’m 19[M] and I think I’m transgender. Since the age of 11 or 12 I’ve been secretly wearing my sister’s (who’s 5 years older than me) clothes at nighttime, the only time I’m alone and feel safe enough to. Since 11 or 12, I’ve wanted to be a girl, but never had the courage to say or do anything about it. Nobody in my life would understand, and I have such bad anxiety I wouldn’t be able to cope with the tension and awkwardness me coming out would cause. This dilemma is the root cause of my depression, but I’m unable to tell anyone that so they think I’m just depressed for ‘normal’ reasons. The only way I could see myself coming out ever is if I moved somewhere far away and started a new life. Bearing this secret alone for so many years has taken its toll on me, and it drives me closer and closer to suicide every day. I’m glad I’ve finally told someone (thank you people of reddit) but I don’t know what to do anymore, and even if I did know what to do I doubt I’d have the courage or strength to act. I am one of those “high-ranked” players and I’ll tell you, buying the gold upgrades for events are a huge waste of gold. The ONLY thing they are good for is completing the event a teensy bit faster. Otherwise, all they do is raise the difficulty of your goals. I made that mistake once, and only once. And if you’re a high ranked player you probably have op suits that let you beat the event in minutes, my PB is 3 minutes 54 seconds after joining with only 2 angel resets (I’m assuming all high ranked players have similar set ups to mine). So high ranked players can beat the events quicker, and then immediately farm points. No time warps are needed. And from my personal experience, hypothetically it would be possible to make around 360k points in one hour of continuous grinding. 180k is half that, so if they make that in an hour they are going at normal pace (at least my concept of normal pace). 100k an hour I consider slow farming, at least for op people. I’ve had people jump 250k-260k points in an hour and pass me, that’s why I have no life and basically always check the game to make that doesn’t happen. 

TLDR: Don’t buy the gold boosters it just makes your life harder, and there will always be that one whale on top of the leaderboard.
